newsitem.title: USA: FirstMerit Corp increases Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: FirstMerit Corp increases Q3 charge.

text.p: FirstMerit Corp said on Friday it increased a previously reported third-quarter charge related to deposit insurance to $0.20 a share from $0.19.
With the revision, the company's third-quarter net income is $13.45 million, or $0.42 a share. On October 15, the company reported third-quarter net income of $13.98 million, or $0.43 a share.
The revision followed an adjustment by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp to the level of Oakar deposits held by one of the company's subsidiaries, FirstMerit said.
